brief: JPM US Market Intelligence stays Tactically Cautious / Neutral into the September 11 CPI, with the Monetization Menu unchanged week over week. Feroli forecasts headline CPI +0.38% m/m and core +0.21% m/m, which is 2.4% core year over year, and treats a rounded 0.2% as low enough for the Fed to hold and 0.3% as high enough to hike. The bond market prices about 63% odds of a 25bp hike on September 16, October at 27% and December at 54%, so the print decides the meeting. The desk maps core outcomes to one-day SPX moves, from a 1.5% to 2.5% decline above 0.30% core to a 1.5% to 2% gain below 0.15%, against options pricing roughly a 1.0% move. Neutral positioning plus hedge fund re-grossing leads the desk to read risk/reward as skewed to the upside, while expected choppiness into the print is what drove the move to neutral. Feroli also expects headline PPI +0.2% m/m. Brent above $100 on US/Iran escalation drove developed market equity weakness. Treasury's $6bn long-end buyback cap disappointed, though the 10-year auction stopped 1.5bp through.
